This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for August 3, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal. Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah. This was reported by BBC News.

2. Middle East crisis live: Iran denies Trump's claims that talks due to take place. Iranian spokesperson says there are no plans to receive or send a delegation following US president's assertion that talks would take place on Monday Iran in talks with Oman over shipping route but not US, says Tehran Earlier today, Esmail Baghaei , Tehran's foreign ministry spokesperson, said that Iran was not reviving talks with the US - despite what Donald Trump told reporters on Sunday. This was reported by The Guardian.

3. Israel defies Trump's peace plan as it escalates deadly attacks on Gaza. Israel escalates Gaza attacks and pushes hardline demands, threatening the US-backed peace roadmap. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

4. 'Tell us': Gaza family trapped between hope and pain over missing brothers. The disappearance of two boys last year has turned the Abdel Aal family's life into an endless search for answers. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the August 3, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
